data.one_liner: A simple Dart tool for applying database schema migrations to SQLite and PostgreSQL.
data.what_it_does: It reads migration scripts from a source (in‑memory or file system) and applies them to a target database. Separate packages provide the actual SQLite or PostgreSQL drivers. The API is minimal and focuses on sequential migration execution.
use_when: You need to version and apply schema changes for SQLite or PostgreSQL databases in a Dart/Flutter project
You want a lightweight, framework‑agnostic migration runner without an ORM
avoid_when: You already use an ORM that includes its own migration system (e.g., drift)
You need advanced migration features like automatic rollbacks or complex dependency graphs
strengths: Very small and easy to add
Works with both SQLite and PostgreSQL via companion packages
Supports in‑memory and filesystem migration sources
weaknesses: No built‑in database drivers – you must add separate packages
Limited feature set compared to full‑featured migration tools
No code‑generation or declarative schema definitions
data.setup_notes: Add migrant to pubspec and also add the appropriate source (migrant_source_fs) and database driver packages (migrant_db_sqlite or migrant_db_postgresql)

alternatives.name: drift
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides an integrated ORM with built‑in migration support and code generation

alternatives.name: sqlparser
alternatives.why_pick_it: Can parse and analyze SQL scripts for custom migration workflows
